description: This file defines an abstract test class for testing classes that extend BaseClientActor in a messaging connectivity context. It includes test methods for connection status, metrics, logs, and TLS connection testing, utilizing Akka actors and HTTP server bindings.

classes.name: AbstractBaseClientActorTest
classes.description: Abstract test class providing common test utilities and test methods for subclasses that test connectivity client actors.

methods.name: retrieveConnectionStatus
methods.description: Tests retrieval of connection status via actor message.

methods.name: retrieveConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Tests retrieval of connection metrics via actor message.

methods.name: resetConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Tests resetting of connection metrics via actor message.

methods.name: retrieveConnectionLogs
methods.description: Tests retrieval of connection logs via actor message.

methods.name: enableConnectionLogs
methods.description: Tests enabling of connection logs via actor message.

methods.name: resetConnectionLogs
methods.description: Tests resetting of connection logs via actor message.

methods.name: testTLSConnectionWithoutCertificateCheck
methods.description: Tests establishing a TLS connection without certificate validation, handling self-signed certificates, and checking for SSL validation errors.
